gen-tourney-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads with a marker-like steadiness and chunky, generously gapped letters, while Tourney stretches out above it in wide-tracked, athletic capitals. Bold meets level-headed here, each keeping to its own lane.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-savate: Savate reads clean and contemporary, with open curves and a rounded o that nearly matches its capital. Savate also holds up at modest sizes, while Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its pen-drawn, outward-pointing strokes for the big, expressive moments.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-ruda: Distinctive from the first glance, Gugi lets its lowercase climb almost to capital height. Gugi is the one to make a statement, while Ruda, wire-thin and wide-mouthed with a generous x-height, does the quieter job of being read comfortably on a screen.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Stubby, whimsical and heavy-handed, Flavors hits like a carpenter's pencil. Noto Sans Tagalog settles beneath it as a plain, middle-weighted sans with generous curve openings, giving the loud heading a steady neighbor that never competes.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans reads modern and friendly, its big-eyed lowercase and tubular strokes bending like copper pipe. Paprika spreads out beside it with commanding, capital-sized lowercase, scattered and hollow-bellied, so the two feel like loud and lean cousins.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-yaldevi: Expressive and loose, Revalia strides across the line with widely separated letters, an open-curved g and short stalks above its band. Yaldevi follows with large, neutral lowercase and an e that opens clearly rightward.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-vend-sans: Stenciled and loud, Snowburst One breaks its letters apart with wide bridges. And Vend Sans, drawn with a ruler-straight line and wide-open curve endings, takes a bigger size comfortably since its x-height already fills the line.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-tiktok-sans: Commanding, Tilt Neon glows with tube-like strokes and a splayed c terminal. TikTok Sans carries a modern, professional ease for longer reading, its x-height rising close to cap height and its c opening generously.
gen-almendra-display-archivo: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display lets its letters breathe, with a pronounced x-height. Archivo steps in as the approachable sans, its curves opening outward and its own commanding x-height keeping the two in step.
gen-gf-offside-gf-sen: Sen brings modern, constant-weight lowercase built high, with curved strokes that stop before turning inward. Sen's steadiness is its strongest asset, a fine foil for Offside's wide-tracked, commanding curves that refuse to close.
